## Objective

Implement the selected draft TRD's complete intent-discovery improvement in the reusable to-trd package, preserve the current contracts, and verify the conversational behavior and mapped Template result.

User value: Users receive requirements that reflect their actual decisions, with clear evidence that the skill asks, pauses, incorporates answers, and respects approval and adoption boundaries.

### Success outcomes

- All 22 source requirements and 73 acceptance criteria have current evidence or an explicitly authorized disposition before implementation completion.
- Ambiguous capture produces a material question and a real pause; actual answers change relevant requirements and acceptance.
- Fully specified requests take the fast path; requested incomplete drafts and follow-up restrictions preserve honest uncertainty.
- All C01–C14 scenarios are defined and exercised, including the required actual-host cases and fresh-session package verification.
- Source and mapped-Template packages meet the preserved mechanical contracts, and protected project-owned artifacts retain their authorized state.
- The final report separates helper results, live conversational evidence, Template checks, authorized adoption, and unexercised behavior.

## Scope

### In scope

- Implement the 22 selected TRD requirements and preserve all 73 acceptance criteria.
- Revise the existing source entry, metadata, discovery reference, contract explanation, body-template wording, example, dependent tests, README, package index, maintenance guidance, and action documentation.
- Add references/interaction-examples.md and tests/interaction-scenarios.md within SKILLS-depo/to-trd.
- Perform baseline, source-package, semantic coverage, all conversational-case, fresh-host, and mapped-Template verification after separate execution authorization.
- Retain concise local implementation evidence beneath Verification/to-trd-intent-discovery and through the separately active canonical plan/Task workflows.
- Use the existing checked Template update mechanism for the to-trd package and report any broader pending mapping work before applying it.

### Out of scope

- Execution under this planning request, TRD approval or lifecycle changes, separate Task activation, agents, model changes, dependency installation, service provisioning, watcher installation/control, Git mutation, or external actions.
- Active-root or ordinary product-project adoption, bulk propagation, global installation, root governance edits, and changes to unrelated Task, memory, registry, or project code.
- A schema revision, new fields or statuses or commands, a separate discovery database, a required questionnaire, or upstream ticket and installation machinery.
- A helper rewrite or optional semantic-lint feature in the proposed initial repair; scripts/trd.py remains protected under the minimal-patch proposal.
- New upstream material, attribution changes, or edits to the retained MIT notice; existing attribution remains sufficient for this bounded adaptation.
- Automatic adoption or rewrite of existing managed or unmanaged plans and historical TRDs.

### Execution authority

This is a proposed managed implementation plan. Creation, tracking, or approval of the plan does not itself authorize implementation, dependency installation, deletion, publication, deployment, external communication, Git changes, or other separately governed action. Execution requires a current instruction identifying the exact approved plan; the source TRD remains a draft observation until separately approved.
